Symbol Quest

Learn your symbols through fun mini-games! Each correct answer moves you along the board path.

🏁 Board Progress: 0/20 spaces
🖼️
See Image → Pick Label
See the symbol image and choose the correct label
🏷️

Read the label and find the matching symbol
✏️
Spell It
See the image and type the correct label
🗂️
Category Quiz
Hear a category, pick the matching word (no images required, screen-reader friendly)
🧠
Symbol Memory
Match symbol images with their labels

Category Quiz needs symbols from at least two different categories, including an action, describing word, or thing. Edit symbol categories in the Symbol Bank to enable it.

text:
🔍
Symbol Search

Train the auditory-to-visual connection that AAC learners need. Hear a word or phrase, then find the matching symbol(s).

Practice:
🎯 All
(8)
🏃 Verbs
(0)
📦 Nouns
(0)
🎨 Adjectives
(0)
💬 Core
(8)
Difficulty:
2 choices
3 choices
4 choices
6 choices
💛 Errorless mode
(beginner — wrong picks retry same target)
Session length:
Unlimited
10 rounds
20 rounds
30 rounds
🔊
Listen & Find
Hear a word, tap the matching symbol
🧩
Listen & Build
Hear a phrase, tap symbols in order to build it
Practice note: Symbol Search gives practice with auditory-to-visual matching — a skill that can support locating symbols from spoken input. Listen & Build adds sequential symbol construction for multi-word utterances. Results feed into Word Garden familiarity tracking and IEP goal recording.
